model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and accuracy, measured as ACC (%). The x-axis represents co-occurrence number on a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 5 to 3000, with tick labels at 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis represents ACC (%) on a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 65, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot features six lines with distinct colors and marker shapes: Base (black with circles), FT (blue with triangles), IKE (red with triangles), MEND (brown with diamonds), MEMIT (purple with triangles), and ROME (green with squares). Starting from the left side of the plot, the Base line begins at approximately 39 and ends at 44; the FT line starts at approximately 40 and ends at 47; the IKE line starts at approximately 43 and ends at 51; the MEND line starts at approximately 43 and ends at 56; the MEMIT line starts at approximately 44 and ends at 54; and the ROME line starts at approximately 51 and ends at 66, steadily increasing across the x-axis with no notable peaks or declines.
